posts.zh:
dsh-notify 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。对话完成通知：回合完成/出错/目标完成/提问/审批时弹出 Windows toast 与提示音，仅后台提醒，会话头部铃铛即控制中心。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1003f3d3dda9f00dd399.html
posts.en:
dsh-notify is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Conversation-completion notifications for DeepSeek Harness: Windows toast + sound on turn done / error / goal, plus ask & approval alerts - background-only, with a volume-adjustable bell in the conversation header.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1003f3d3dda9f00dd399.html
